summary: Read a binary tree in which every node holds a single digit from 0 to 9. Walk from the root down to a leaf, meaning a node that has no child, and join the digits from that walk into one integer, high digit first. Passing through 1, then 2, then 3 produces 123. Build one integer for every root-to-leaf walk, add those integers, and write the sum.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a level-order node count, using a dot for a missing child.
